scope: 2 genuine NCCL ranks on this box's one real GPU behind the 7q3w.4 aliased-device shims, over the modelled IB wire. A measured BOTH the result claims (exact 1 MiB allreduce, rank r fills r+1 => 3.0; and a 4096-byte send/recv that must be BYTE-IDENTICAL), and the control separates two different questions: C (no progress thread) shows the async pump is NECESSARY; D (FAKEIB_LAZY_PUMP=1, the pre-fix lazy start) shows that STARTING IT AT DEVICE OPEN is the fix. B is the p2p claim on its own, with no prior collective. Each phase ran 5x.

shape_chosen.answer: neither (a) host compute nor (b) kernel execution
shape_chosen.why: With 7q3w.4's aliasing the kernel launches are REAL, so the arithmetic is real float32 on this box's GPU; only the TRANSPORT between the two processes is modelled.

margin.meaning: B completes in well under a quarter of the rank timeout, while every C and D run was still wedged when the timeout killed it; the wedge is a deadlock, not a slow path.

wedge_signature.where: rank1 (receiver) log of every C and D run
wedge_signature.shape: rank1 (receiver) posts its 64-byte connection info -- ring_put(1,0) kind=2 nbytes=64, so its poll line reads out=1 in=0 -- and rank0 (sender) has NO deliver_inbound line at all: it never saw the record, never posted the 4096-byte data WR, and rank1 never received a payload. The passing runs (B) show the missing pair: rank0 posts len=4096 and rank1 delivers nbytes=4096.

error_budget.measured_real: NCCL 2.32.6 chose our mlx5_0 (NET/IB, no Socket fallback in any run); its own kernels ran on the real GPU; rank0's trace shows the 4096-byte payload posted to the wire; counters show post_send_calls/bytes_written/ring records > 0 and no rnr_drops or remote_access_errors in every passing run.
error_budget.modelled: The wire: libibverbs is a shim and the fabric is a MAP_SHARED byte ring per rank pair with modelled bandwidth/latency on completion readiness. Inbound progress is asynchronous (pump thread, 50 us default), which adds real delivery latency; that latency is the pump, not the modelled wire time.
error_budget.not_modelled: No physical NIC or DMA, no GDR/dmabuf registration (7q3w.6, NOT EXERCISED by design), no second GPU and therefore no B300 compute time (a collective's compute time is this 5090's). No 8-way collective or training step here, and no performance claim (ae2v).
error_budget.model_defect_found_and_fixed: Inbound records used to be delivered only inside poll_cq, so a sender spinning on the peer-written host FIFO could never be progressed; then the progress thread itself was started lazily from poll_cq, which a p2p-alone sender never calls. Both are measured: C and D wedge, B does not.
